harbor_extra_docker_steps: python3 -c "import hashlib, json, pathlib; t = pathlib.Path(\"/data/wikitext2/wikitext/wikitext-2-raw-v1/0.0.0/b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3/wikitext-test.arrow\"); assert hashlib.sha256(t.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == \"2b8a3efac7b468cbe6432edba5f55c21e435d93873acc6727431f08d5ed328ea\", \"unexpected wikitext-test.arrow\"; q = pathlib.Path(\"/data/wikitext2/downloads/5e548f01091b2f01906ea7be35b8a1a6aa74842629dc550b7a02ca0821f1002d\"); assert \"test-00000-of-00001.parquet\" in json.loads(pathlib.Path(str(q) + \".json\").read_text())[\"url\"]; [p.unlink() for p in (t, q, pathlib.Path(str(q) + \".json\"))]; pathlib.Path(\"/data/wikitext2/.mlsb_test_withheld\").write_text(\"The WikiText-2 test split is withheld from the workspace and mounted only for the final evaluation.\"); print(\"withheld: WikiText-2 test split\")"
_harbor_extra_docker_steps_note: The WikiText-2 test split (the scored perplexity) is withheld from the agent-visible image: the first step asserts the cached test arrow by sha256 and deletes it together with the downloaded test parquet, leaving a .mlsb_test_withheld marker; the second proves no copy is left. The split lives in holdout/<task>/data/withheld/ (tests/meta/ in the bundle, mounted only at verification); scripts/_withheld.sh rebuilds a complete cache under $OUTPUT_DIR, checks the restored file's sha256 and points HF_DATASETS_CACHE at it, and the eval scripts set MLSB_REQUIRE_TEST_SPLIT=1 so get_eval_data can never fall back. In the agent's own runs get_eval_data uses the validation split and says so.
